name: Morbius
summary: Michael Morbius is a living vampire who debuted in Spider-Man’s comic and later carried horror stories of his own. He is an antihero as often as an enemy. A 2022 film used his name outside this archive’s film list.
relation: Debuted as a Spider-Man antagonist. Later a horror lead, not a core rogue.
powers: A pseudo-vampiric condition: strength, flight, and a need for blood, without the traditional undead rules in every story.
origin: A biochemist’s attempt to cure his own blood disease creates the condition.
